chapters.label: Live: the 2004 semi-final
chapters.text: Taipei, 2004: the Futsal World Cup semi-final, Spain against Brazil. Julio is Spain’s fixo. It ends two all, so penalties! Julio steps up and scores, and Spain win the shootout!

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: A fixo can steal passes too. This is how he does it: he stays close behind the pivot. The pass comes, he steps in front at the right moment, steals it and attacks!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Stay close, watch the pass, step in front!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: step in front of your attacker at the right moment to steal the pass!
